items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: He used to laugh at Tats with his buddies, Albert's sister.

ctx.x: I'm B, that looks like Tats has an album. Hmm? And Cherie has a bone system.
Yeah, well, Cherie always did have a bone system. Always did. That's funny. Yeah, but that's what he always had. He used to laugh at Tats with his buddies, Albert's sister. Yeah.
